Pine reference adaptations in XiheTradingTerminal
===============================================

The following 28 reference scripts carry Copyright (c) LuxAlgo and are licensed
under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
Legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode.en

Their source-derived TypeScript adaptations and related source-derived guide
material retain that attribution and license; they are not relicensed as MIT.
Changes: Pine defaults reimplemented in TypeScript; declarative drawing output,
Binance data integration, bounded history/rendering, original-palette handling,
local explanatory guides, and explicitly documented unsupported/changed behavior.
There is no endorsement by LuxAlgo or TradingView. The original Pine references
are in third-party/tradingview-indicator/ in the source repository; they are not
included in the VSIX. Compiled adaptations are included in the Webview bundle.
The repository's doc/pine-indicators.md lists per-preset scope and differences.

Attribution, noncommercial use, and ShareAlike conditions apply to adaptations.
See the license above for the actual terms. Core extension code and independently
implemented original presets retain their own license; this notice does not
relicense unrelated files.
